purpose: Annual 2025 borough-level road-safety analysis of police-reported crashes, with geographic and vehicle-category summaries.
purpose_status: Analyst-defined scope; no interviews or NYPD stakeholder approval claimed.

book_references.dimensions: Chapter 13, printed pp. 460-462, Table 29; PDF pp. 464-466
book_references.metrics: Chapter 13, printed pp. 482-483, Table 30; PDF pp. 486-487

book.title: DAMA-DMBOK2
book.six_dimensions: DAMA UK six core dimensions discussed on printed p. 460, selected by the assignment. DMBOK2 also discusses broader frameworks.

spatial.limits: Conditional on correct coordinates; current land-only polygons; approximate boundary band. Agreement is not ground-truth crash-location accuracy. No recovery was applied.

source_freshness.interpretation: Source-level metadata freshness observed once; not first-publication latency or proof of daily SLA adherence.

representation.numeric_api_strings: Expected Socrata serialization; validated logically after parsing

duplicate_event_candidates.rule: Exact equality on all 28 published non-ID fields; missing absent values normalized to null for comparison. No deletion or confirmed event-identity claim.

metrics.rule: Core ID, date, time and person totals are present

metrics.rule: Both coordinate components are populated

limitations: No blanket field-completeness score: optional/conditional vehicle slots, addresses, factors and ZIP are profiled without declaring every blank erroneous.
No composite score or universal acceptability threshold. Structural domains are explicit; operational targets require stakeholder agreement.
No original event/coordinate/count accuracy audit, no independently reconciled total event population, no operational latency measurement.
Current land-only reference polygons are compared with 2025 events, with an approximate boundary exclusion. Reference disagreement is a review flag.
Recovery candidates are conditional proposals; no cleaned dataset or claimed achieved after-score is produced.
Issue counts overlap and mix records/cells; do not add them to estimate unique defective records.
No root cause is established solely from profiling; source capture, coding, geocoding and extraction hypotheses need owner review.
